title: Test case for the memory layer (not the real case; Person 3 owns cases/)

suspects.persona: Stiff, formal, protective of the household.
Warm, chatty, notices everything in the kitchen.

evidence.text: The gardener's note: he saw the butler go into the cellar after midnight.

events.replacement: The gardener now says he saw no one that night.

seed_memories.text: I was polishing the silver in the pantry from eleven until two. I never left the pantry.
Just after midnight I heard heavy footsteps going down the cellar stairs.
When I passed the pantry at half past twelve the silver was laid out but nobody was there.
